title: First steps
description: Open a PDF, find your way around, add some text and save it.

steps.title: Open a PDF
steps.text: Click Open and choose a PDF from your computer (Ctrl+O). You can also drop a file onto the window.

steps.title: Change page
steps.text: Type a page number in this box and press Enter to jump to it. The arrows beside it move one page at a time.

steps.title: Zoom in or out
steps.text: Pick a zoom level from this list, such as Fit width. The minus and plus buttons next to it zoom step by step.

steps.title: See every page
steps.text: Open the sidebar and use the Thumbnails tab to see small pictures of all the pages. Click one to go to that page.

steps.title: Choose the Text tool
steps.text: Click the Text tool, or press T.

steps.title: Type on the page
steps.text: Click on the page where the text should go and type something. Press Ctrl+Enter when you have finished.

steps.title: Save your work
steps.text: Click Save to keep your text in the file (Ctrl+S).

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Open the Help menu, or press F1, to read the user guide and start another tour.
